description: APPLICATION FOR VARIATION OF CONDITION 2 (APPROVED PLANS) AND 18 (OBSCURED GLAZING) ATTACHED TO LBM PLANNING APPLICATION 24/P2870 RELATING TO THE DEMOLITION OF EXISTING TWO STOREY DWELLING AND REPLACEMENT WITH A TWO STOREY DWELLING PLUS BASEMENT LEVEL),  OUTDOOR SWIMMING POOL AND ASSOCIATED LANDSCAPING. CHANGES RELATE TO  'removal of the approvedexternal basement staircase, alterationsto approved glazing and use of vertical louvres tothe first floor master bedroom and hallway insteadof obscure glazing.
decision_conditions: <p>With the exception of condition 1, 2 and 18,&nbsp;<span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">all other conditions attached to permission&nbsp;</span><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">24/P2870 are applicable to this planning permission.&nbsp;</span></p><p><br></p><p>Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and to comply with the development plan.&nbsp;</p>

<p>The vertical louvres to the first floor master bedroom and hallway windows shall be opaque and shall be installed in accordance with the approved plans, with the angle of the louvres fixed as shown on those plans, prior to first occupation of the development and shall be retained as such thereafter.</p><p>Reason: In the interests of protecting neighbouring amenity and to comply with Merton Local Plan 2024 policy D12.3<span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11.5pt;"><br></span></p>
